$note: Double bass, pizzicato, a sample every minor third (MIDI number = sounding pitch); other notes are pitch-shifted from the nearest one. tune = cents to add at playback (measured), vol = dB to add so every note has the same mean level. From Meatbass (Karoryfer Samples; played by Drogomir Smolken, recorded by Ludwik Zamenhof), CC0 1.0: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/karoryfer.meatbass
